verdict.rationale: Luma is an AI video generator, so a script-to-presenter avatar video is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only general text-to-video, character reference, and facial expression transfer. There is no documented script-to-speech presenter, lip-synced talking head, or stock or custom avatar library. These features are adjacent to the story and do not deliver it.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio
